tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The sign flip of a smooth form along a smooth section is smooth]

↗ def:sign-flipped-form ↗ lem:tensor-product-one-forms-smooth

If $b$ and $u$ are smooth, then $\flip (b,u)$ is a smooth field of bilinear forms.

Proof

↗ lem:tensor-product-one-forms-smooth \sketch The $1$-form $b(u,\cdot )$ is smooth, so its tensor square is smooth by Lemma 16; take the indicated linear combination with $b$.

□
